name: Vallegarcía

known.via: English Wikipedia "Vallegarcía" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: A wine from a pago, a named rural site with its own soil and microclimate. All its grapes must grow there.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A single-estate Vino de Pago in Castilla-La Mancha. Its red grapes are Syrah, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot, Garnacha Tinta, Mazuelo and Monastrell, with Viognier the only white grape.
